After comparing Sumin's words, 'I should have endured it' and the groom-to-be's message, it appears that it was the groom-to-be who crossed the line. Let's ask the new witness about the relevant facts.

Combining Sumin's words about trying to hold back and Da-eun's father's text message, it seems likely that the current contact is not just a personal contact. The actual party and purpose of the money matter must be ascertained in the interrogation.
If you juxtapose the assertion, “I’m contacting my man again,” with the self-reproach, “I should have held back,” it becomes clear that you are experiencing the same incident completely differently.
